Synopsis:
Mizora goes to players camp whether or not Wyll keeps the pact.

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_Mizora.json: Mizora has come to the player’s camp to confront or gloat about Wyll’s recent decision — she appears whether Wyll honored or broke his pact — and opens by remarking on how “grown up” he is. The player’s reply accuses Mizora of forcing Wyll into an impossible choice, so the exchange assumes a prior scene in which Wyll was compelled to decide about a pact or deal. Off‑screen, the party has just disturbed a nearby windmill (flinging a small gnome/birdy), which drew goblin scouts away and may have prompted topical companion remarks; the player may also be carrying the Moonlantern/pixie and weighing whether to free it, which figures into nearby tensions. Companions’ topical greetings or reactions (Halsin, Astarion, Lae’zel, Minthara, Jaheira, etc.) may be active based on these recent events.
- CAMP_MizorasPact_CFM.json: The player enters the camp, and Mizora is waiting with three cronies. She makes a pact with Wyll: Pact with Mizora and save his father, or refuse and ensure his death.
- CAMP_MizorasJudgement_CFM.json: After meeting Karlach and choosing whether to keep her alive or kill her, Mizora appears in camp to turn Wyll into a devil or reward him with a new power.
- WYR_MeetingMizora_OM_Wyll_COM_AOM_OOM.json: Dialog with mizora at Wyrm's Rock near the entrance to Lower city. She is in human form. Wyll sees his father taken away, and Mizora tells him to meet him in camp.
- Wyll_Recruitment_PostDruidAttack_PostEA.json: Post EADialogue with Wyll after Druid Attack. In most cases, this will involve him training a tiefling child before the player breaks in, and you discover you were both on the mind flayer ship. Wyll comes across as a big-time hero, and wants help killing goblins. He is called the Blade of Frontiers by most.
